main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (5-day return minus coin's normal drift), non-overlapping 5-bar grid, before costs
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 grid cases with a non-zero forecast

decided_by: Inconclusive rule met: -2 < t < 2 with at least 300 grid cases with a non-zero forecast.
reading: The mean and t are taken over every grid cell (bars 0, 5, 10, ... of each window with a 5-bar return inside it, zero-forecast cells contributing 0), the normal drift is each coin's mean 5-bar return over that grid in all its windows, and the 300 minimum is counted on grid cells with a non-zero forecast.
